scheme_name: Haryana Pre Matric Scholarship For Minority
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, or Zoroastrian (Parsi) community in Haryana
Applicant must be studying in classes 1 to 10 in a government or private school selected and notified by the State Government in Haryana
Applicant must have secured at least 50% marks in the previous final examination
Applicant must be a regular student in the school
30% of scholarships are earmarked for girl students (preference)
Priority is given based on poverty rather than marks
Renewal applications are considered before new applications
benefits_summary: Scholarships cover admission fee up to ₹500 per annum, tuition fee up to ₹350 per month, and maintenance allowance ranging from ₹100 to ₹600 per month for classes 1‑10.
